title: Do Deficits Cause Inflation? A High Frequency Narrative Approach
title_zh: 赤字会导致通货膨胀吗？高频叙事方法研究
title_primary: 赤字会导致通货膨胀吗？高频叙事方法研究
title_secondary: Do Deficits Cause Inflation? A High Frequency Narrative Approach
authors: Jonathon Hazell, Stephan Hobler
official: 官方在线 2025-02-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper measures the causal effect of deficits on inflation using a “high frequency narrative approach”. We identify an event that released news about the 2021 deficits in the United States—the Georgia Senate election runoff. We calculate the size of the shock using new narrative data from investment banks. We then study the high frequency response of inflation forecasts from asset prices, in order to separate deficits from other factors affecting inflation. We estimate an “inflation multiplier” of 0.19% price level growth over two years, for a 1% deficit-to-GDP shock. Our estimate implies that the 2021 deficits caused around a third of the 2021-22 inflation—meaning deficits were important but not the only cause. A heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model quantitatively matches the size and dynamics of the inflation multiplier.
abstract_zh: 本文采用“高频叙事方法”衡量赤字对通胀的因果效应。我们识别出一个释放了2021年美国赤字相关新闻的事件——佐治亚州参议院决选。我们利用来自投资银行的新叙事数据计算冲击规模。随后，我们研究资产价格通胀预测的高频反应，以将赤字与其他影响通胀的因素区分开来。我们估计，对于1%的赤字占GDP比例冲击，两年内价格水平增长的“通胀乘数”为0.19%。我们的估计表明，2021年的赤字导致了2021-22年通胀的大约三分之一——这意味着赤字是重要因素，但并非唯一原因。一个异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型在数量上匹配了通胀乘数的大小和动态特征。

title: DP13059 Politically feasible reforms of non-linear tax systems
title_zh: 非线性税收制度的政治可行性改革
title_primary: 非线性税收制度的政治可行性改革
title_secondary: DP13059 Politically feasible reforms of non-linear tax systems
authors: Felix Bierbrauer, Pierre Boyer
official: 官方在线 2018-07-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present a conceptual framework for the analysis of politically feasible tax reforms. First, we prove a median voter theorem for monotonic reforms of non-linear tax systems. This yields a characterization of reforms that are preferred by a majority of individuals over the status quo and hence politically feasible. Second, we show that every Pareto-efficient tax system is such that moving towards lower tax rates for below-median incomes and towards higher rates for above median incomes is politically feasible. Third, we develop a method for diagnosing whether a given tax system admits reforms that are politically feasible and/or welfare-improving
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个分析政治可行税制改革的概念框架。首先，我们证明了非线性税制单调改革的中间选民定理。这得出了多数个体相对于现状偏好且因此政治可行的改革特征。其次，我们表明，每个帕累托效率税制都使得向低于中位收入者降低税率、向高于中位收入者提高税率的变动在政治上是可行的。第三，我们开发了一种方法，用于诊断给定税制是否存在既政治可行又增进福利的改革。

title: Health, Gender Division of Labor, and Productivity
title_zh: 健康、性别分工与生产率
title_primary: 健康、性别分工与生产率
title_secondary: Health, Gender Division of Labor, and Productivity
authors: Yao Yao
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the impact of health on structural transformation and aggregate productivity in low-income economies through its effects on the gender-based division of labor across sectors. I develop a two-sector general equilibrium model in which returns to health are higher for men than for women in agriculture, implying that health improvements reallocate female labor toward nonagriculture. The model is calibrated to African economies. Quantitative results show that health improvements substantially reduce the agricultural employment share—particularly among women—and increase aggregate labor productivity. Over one-third of the productivity gains can be attributed to the gender-based division of labor. Policy experiments indicate that health subsidies are more effective than education subsidies in reducing women’s agricultural employment relative to men’s and in improving aggregate productivity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了健康状况如何通过影响性别分工在不同部门间的分布，进而对低收入经济体的结构转型和总体生产率产生影响。我构建了一个两部门一般均衡模型，在该模型中，农业部门中男性健康回报高于女性，这意味着健康改善会促使女性劳动力向非农业部门转移。模型针对非洲经济体进行了校准。定量结果显示，健康改善显著降低了农业就业份额——尤其是女性农业就业份额——并提高了总体劳动生产率。超过三分之一的生产率提升可归因于基于性别的劳动分工。政策实验表明，相较于教育补贴，健康补贴在减少女性相对于男性的农业就业、提升总体生产率和福利方面更为有效。

abstract_zh: 组合多轮递增拍卖（CMRA）是近年来欧洲频谱拍卖中采用的新型拍卖形式。我们证明，在特定拍卖情境下，真实报价策略能够实现有效配置。随后，我们刻画了包含真实报价、需求扩张与需求缩减等不同特征的序贯均衡。真实报价均衡对竞拍者上限的微小不对称性十分敏感。此外，若竞拍者具有充分对称性，CMRA易受无风险合谋行为影响。我们提出一种替代性活动规则，该规则在保持其他均衡不变的前提下，能够阻止此类合谋策略。结合均衡预测结果，我们分析了丹麦多次CMRA的拍卖结果。（JEL D44, H82, L82）

title: The First 1,000 Days and Beyond: The Process of Child Development
title_zh: 最初的1000天及以后：儿童发展的过程
title_primary: 最初的1000天及以后：儿童发展的过程
title_secondary: The First 1,000 Days and Beyond: The Process of Child Development
authors: Attanasio, Orazio P.
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper reviews recent research in the economics of human development, focusing on the early years of life as a critical period for shaping long-term outcomes. Early childhood development is inherently multidimensional: cognitive and socioemotional skills evolve dynamically and interact with health, nutritional, and environmental influences. Economists have contributed to this field by providing a conceptual and unifying framework that highlights how key drivers of development reflect the choices of individuals operating under both incentives and constraints. The paper emphasizes two central challenges: understanding the interactions among multiple dimensions of development and identifying causal links, particularly the effects of different inputs at different ages. Measurement issues are a recurring theme, given the difficulty of assessing young children and the need for comparability across contexts. By discussing early childhood interventions in both developed and developing countries, the paper also stresses these issues’ policy relevance for poverty reduction and social mobility.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了人类发展经济学领域的最新研究，重点关注生命早期阶段作为塑造长期结果的关键时期。儿童早期发展本质上是多维的：认知与社会情感技能动态演进，并与健康、营养及环境影响相互作用。经济学家通过提供概念性与统一性框架为该领域作出贡献，该框架强调发展的关键驱动因素如何反映个体在激励与约束条件下的选择。本文着重探讨两大核心挑战：理解发展各维度间的相互作用，以及识别因果关联——特别是不同年龄阶段不同投入要素的影响效应。鉴于低龄儿童评估的困难性及跨情境可比性的需求，测量问题成为贯穿全文的反复议题。通过讨论发达国家与发展中国家的早期儿童干预措施，本文亦强调这些议题对减贫与社会流动性的政策相关性。

title: The Accuracy and Malleability of Parental Beliefs about Child Socio-Emotional Health
title_zh: 父母关于儿童社会情感健康信念的准确性与可塑性
title_primary: 父母关于儿童社会情感健康信念的准确性与可塑性
title_secondary: The Accuracy and Malleability of Parental Beliefs about Child Socio-Emotional Health
authors: Audrey Bousselin, Isabelle Brocas, Giorgia Menta, Eugenio Proto
official: 官方在线 2026-03-06 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we develop a simple theoretical framework showing how parent–child gaps can arise from information frictions and differences in reporting styles. We complement the model with a novel survey design that elicits both parental beliefs about children’s latent socio-emotional wellbeing and parental beliefs about children’s self-reports, allowing us to disentangle the different sources of the discrepancy. Using a new survey from Luxembourg, we estimate that approximately 70% of the observed gap is attributable to information frictions. Consistent with a Bayesian model of signal extraction, belief accuracy declines when children experience high levels of distress. The precision of second-order beliefs is negatively correlated with parental education, income, and employment, and—paradoxically—with more accurate priors about aggregate parental under-reporting, a pattern we refer to as the Capacity Paradox. As predicted by the model, a randomized information intervention shifts both first- and second-order beliefs only among parents with weak priors and generates heterogeneous effects on intended parental investments. These findings highlight the central role of second-order beliefs in understanding parental misperceptions and the potential for targeted information policies to improve parental awareness of children’s socio-emotional wellbeing.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简洁的理论框架，揭示了信息摩擦与报告风格差异如何导致亲子认知差距。为补充该模型，我们设计了一项新颖的问卷调查，同时获取父母对子女潜在社会情感福祉的信念，以及父母对子女自我报告的信念，从而能够区分认知偏差的不同来源。基于卢森堡的一项新调查数据，我们估计约70%的观测差距可归因于信息摩擦。与贝叶斯信号提取模型一致，当儿童经历高度痛苦时，父母信念的准确性会下降。二阶信念的精确度与父母教育水平、收入及就业状况呈负相关，且与父母对总体低报现象的准确先验信念呈负相关——这种矛盾模式被称为“能力悖论”。正如模型所预测，一项随机信息干预仅对先验信念较弱的父母群体产生一阶与二阶信念的同步偏移，并对预期养育投入产生异质性影响。这些发现凸显了二阶信念在理解父母认知偏差中的核心作用，以及定向信息政策在提升父母对子女社会情感福祉认知方面的潜在价值。

title: Dollar Funding Fragility and non-US Global Banks
title_zh: 美元融资脆弱性与非美国全球银行
title_primary: 美元融资脆弱性与非美国全球银行
title_secondary: Dollar Funding Fragility and non-US Global Banks
authors: Bacchetta, Philippe, Davis, J. Scott, van Wincoop, Eric
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Global non-US banks have significant dollar exposure both on and off their balance sheet. We develop a model to analyze their adjustment to dollar funding shocks, whether from reduced direct lending or external dollar shortages. The model provides insight into banks' responses through borrowing, lending, and FX swap positions, as well as the impact on their net worth, their probability of default and CIP deviations. Implications of the model are confronted with data on the response of non-US global banks to major dollar funding shocks. We examine the benefits from buffering these shocks through central bank dollar swap lines or local currency lending by the central bank.
abstract_zh: 全球非美国银行在表内和表外均持有大量美元敞口。我们构建了一个模型，分析这些银行如何应对美元融资冲击——无论是来自直接贷款减少还是外部美元短缺。该模型揭示了银行通过借款、贷款及外汇掉期头寸的调整机制，以及这些调整对其净资产、违约概率和抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离的影响。我们将模型推论与全球非美国银行应对重大美元融资冲击的实际数据进行了对比验证。此外，我们评估了通过央行美元互换额度或央行本币贷款缓冲此类冲击的潜在收益。

title: Labor Market Effects of Public Employment Guarantee
title_zh: 公共就业保障的劳动力市场效应
title_primary: 公共就业保障的劳动力市场效应
title_secondary: Labor Market Effects of Public Employment Guarantee
authors: Elkhateeb, Yasmine, Elmallakh, Nelly, Flabbi, Luca, Gatti, Roberta, Saleh, Mohamed
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Public employment guarantee schemes, which channeled graduates into lifetime positions in the civil service and state-owned enterprises, were central to state-led industrialization across the postcolonial world, yet they have remained far less studied than temporary workfare programs. This paper provides the first causal estimates of their labor market effects, exploiting the Arab Republic of Egypt's archetypal public employment guarantee, which from the early 1960s guaranteed public sector jobs to secondary and university graduates without competitive examination. The paper measures district-level exposure by secondary school supply on the eve of the reform (1959/60) and links it to individual-level census microdata from 1986, 1996, and 2006. Using an event-study design with continuous treatment intensity, the analysis compares cohorts that differed in age at the time of the public employment guarantee's introduction across districts with differing pre-reform school supply. The findings show that the public employment guarantee reallocated urban male wage employment away from the private sector and toward state-owned enterprises, with no comparable shift in rural districts, where state-owned enterprises were largely absent. The reallocation was concentrated in manufacturing and high-skilled white-collar occupations, consistent with the policy channeling educated workers into sectors that were central to the state's industrialization drive. The paper finds little evidence that the public employment guarantee raised educational attainment, indicating that it primarily redirected an already growing pool of educated workers rather than expanding the supply of schooling.
abstract_zh: 公共就业保障计划是后殖民世界国家主导工业化的核心举措，它将毕业生引入公务员和国有企业的终身职位，但相较于临时工作福利计划，其研究程度远为不足。本文首次对其劳动力市场效应进行因果估计，利用阿拉伯埃及共和国的典型公共就业保障制度——自20世纪60年代初起，该制度保证中学和大学毕业生无需竞争性考试即可获得公共部门职位。本文以改革前夕（1959/60年）的中学供给衡量地区级暴露程度，并将其与1986年、1996年和2006年的人口普查个体微观数据相关联。采用连续处理强度的事件研究设计，分析比较了在公共就业保障制度引入时年龄不同的队列，这些队列分布在改革前学校供给存在差异的地区。研究结果表明，公共就业保障将城市男性工资就业从私营部门重新配置到国有企业，而在国有企业基本缺失的农村地区则未出现类似转变。这种重新配置集中于制造业和高技能白领职业，与政策将受教育工人引导至国家工业化核心部门的逻辑一致。本文未发现公共就业保障显著提高教育程度的证据，表明其主要重新引导了本已增长的受教育工人群体，而非扩大教育供给。

title: Awareness of General Equilibrium Effects and Unemployment
title_zh: 一般均衡效应与失业的认知
title_primary: 一般均衡效应与失业的认知
title_secondary: Awareness of General Equilibrium Effects and Unemployment
authors: Hans Gersbach, Achim Schniewind, Alexia Delfino, Andrea Garnero, Sergio Inferrera 等
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine wage bargaining in a two-sector economy when the employers and labour unions in each sector are not always aware of all the general equilibrium feedback effects. We show analytically that if agents only consider labour demand effects, low real wages and low unemployment are the result. With an intermediate view, i.e. when partial equilibrium effects within a sector are taken into account, high real wages and unemployment result. If all general equilibrium effects are simultaneously considered, we once again obtain a situation of low wages and unemployment. The assumption that unions and employers' federations are unable to incorporate all feedback effects from other sectors may explain why unemployment in Europe is high.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了两部门经济中的工资谈判问题，假设各部门的雇主和工会并非总能意识到所有一般均衡反馈效应。分析表明，若经济主体仅考虑劳动力需求效应，将导致实际工资偏低且失业率较低；若采用中间视角（即考虑部门内的局部均衡效应），则会出现实际工资偏高且失业率较高的情况；而当所有一般均衡效应被同时纳入考量时，低工资与低失业率的局面将再次出现。工会与雇主联合会无法完全纳入其他部门的反馈效应这一假设，或可解释欧洲高失业率的原因。

title: AI Adoption, Carbon Intensity, and Rebound Effect: Evidence from China
title_zh: 人工智能采纳、碳强度与反弹效应：来自中国的证据

authors: Houde, Sébastien, Wang, Wenjun
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between AI adoption and carbon emission intensity. Using micro-level data from Chinese firms, we find that carbon intensity decreases following the adoption of AI. The effect is particularly pronounced among large firms, those headquartered in AI hubs, and those in high-carbon intensity sectors. We investigate several mechanisms and find that AI adoption is also associated with increases in energy management processes, green innovation, inventory efficiency, overall productivity, and the share of specialized labor. We find that AI-induced carbon reductions are subject to a large rebound effect of approximately 70%.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能应用与碳排放强度之间的关系。基于中国企业层面的微观数据，我们发现企业在采用人工智能后，其碳排放强度有所下降。这一效应在大型企业、总部位于人工智能枢纽的企业以及高碳排放强度行业的企业中尤为显著。我们研究了若干机制，发现人工智能应用还与能源管理流程、绿色创新、库存效率、整体生产率以及专业劳动力占比的提升相关。此外，我们发现人工智能带来的碳减排效应存在约70%的大幅反弹效应。

title: Optimal Costly Oversight with Investment and Cream-Skimming
title_zh: 投资与撇脂行为下的最优高成本监管
title_primary: 投资与撇脂行为下的最优高成本监管
title_secondary: Optimal Costly Oversight with Investment and Cream-Skimming
authors: Akin, Sumeyra, Heumann, Tibor
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Transplant center oversight—conducted through costly flagging based on survival rates—is intended to improve outcomes. However, it has faced challenges because centers strategically select patients (and organs) to improve their reported outcomes. We study the optimal flagging policy using a mechanism-design model in which heterogeneous centers can improve their survival rates by investing, selecting patients, or both. We find that (a) the optimal mechanism never flags intrinsically good-enough center types, and (b) under the optimal mechanism, intrinsically worse centers select patients, while intrinsically better centers underinvest. These results apply to the regulation of charter schools and development banks.
abstract_zh: 移植中心监管——通过基于存活率的成本高昂的标记机制——旨在改善治疗结果。然而，该机制面临挑战，因为中心会策略性地选择患者（及器官）以提升其报告结果。我们采用机制设计模型研究最优标记政策，其中异质性中心可通过投资、患者选择或两者结合来改善存活率。研究发现：(a) 最优机制从不标记内在质量足够好的中心类型；(b) 在最优机制下，内在质量较差的中心会进行患者选择，而内在质量较好的中心则投资不足。这些结论同样适用于特许学校与开发银行的监管。

title: A generational challenge: Turning a record youth surge into a jobs dividend
title_zh: 代际挑战：将创纪录的青年人口激增转化为就业红利
title_primary: 代际挑战：将创纪录的青年人口激增转化为就业红利
title_secondary: A generational challenge: Turning a record youth surge into a jobs dividend
authors: Tommy Chrimes, M. Ayhan Kose, Kersten Stamm
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Between 2025 and 2035, the largest-ever cohort of young people in emerging market and developing economies will reach working age. Slowing growth, overlapping crises, tight fiscal conditions, and weak job-creation capacity in many countries make creating enough good jobs for this generation one of the defining development challenges of the next decade. This column argues that, with determined policy action, this demographic wave can become a powerful engine of growth, poverty reduction, and development progress.
abstract_zh: 2025年至2035年间，新兴市场和发展中经济体将迎来史上规模最大的青年群体进入劳动年龄。然而，多国面临增长放缓、危机叠加、财政紧缩及就业创造能力疲软等困境，如何为这一代人创造充足的优质就业岗位，将成为未来十年最具标志性的发展挑战。本文认为，若采取果断的政策行动，这一人口浪潮有望转化为推动经济增长、减贫与发展进程的强大引擎。

title: Taking geopolitically motivated US swap lines too far would harm the dollar and Fed independence
title_zh: 将地缘政治驱动的美国互换额度推得太远将损害美元和美联储独立性
title_primary: 将地缘政治驱动的美国互换额度推得太远将损害美元和美联储独立性
title_secondary: Taking geopolitically motivated US swap lines too far would harm the dollar and Fed independence
authors: Adnan Mazarei, Maurice Obstfeld
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.
abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪以来，美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但适当的流动性注入模式取决于经济、金融和地缘政治背景。当地缘政治关切占主导地位时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道，而美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，并更少受短期外交政策动机的影响。迄今为止，法律、规范和政府间谅解在一定程度上约束了这些对外贷款渠道的政治滥用，但已无法假定各方会继续遵守，因此需要更正式的防护措施。

title: Different Market, Same Treatment? A Global Comparison of Hiring and Housing Discrimination
title_zh: 不同市场，相同待遇？全球招聘与住房歧视比较研究
title_primary: 不同市场，相同待遇？全球招聘与住房歧视比较研究
title_secondary: Different Market, Same Treatment? A Global Comparison of Hiring and Housing Discrimination
authors: Devos, Louise, Lippens, Louis, Baert, Stijn, Verhaeghe, Pieter-Paul
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The effects of the bank levy in Poland on the broadly defined credit market (including on loan rates and volumes) appear to be well documented, with the use of the standard difference-in-differences (DID) method. However, as, for example, Borusyak et al. (2024) note, in a setting with staggered treatment (as in the case of the bank levy in Poland), and different effects of the treatment in time and between cross-sections, the method might provide biased estimates. None of the studies to date used the heterogenous DID method that addresses this drawback. In this research note I use the heterogenous DID method to estimate the consequences of the bank levy. I also discuss other methodological choices. Among other things, I find that the bank levy has lowered deposit rates, raised rates on loans for house purchases, and changed the composition and the level of bank assets. However, I find no longer-term crowding out of credit by government bond securities (while the latter did increase, the former did not increase) or effects on bank profitability. The use of a more advised method did not lead to results in stark contrast with the earlier literature applying methods for causal inference.
abstract_zh: 尽管大量实证研究记录了劳动力和住房市场中的歧视现象，但这两个市场之间的比较性见解仍然有限。我们通过对比五个受法律保护领域——种族与民族、性别与性别认同、健康与残疾、性取向以及社会出身——在两个市场中的歧视程度来填补这一空白。我们采用分层贝叶斯元回归方法，对2000年至2024年间全球通信审计研究的数据进行分析。在此过程中，我们考虑了元数据的多层次结构，包括研究、群体、地点和时间等组成部分。我们的元分析揭示了歧视的结构性差异：种族与民族歧视在劳动力市场中最为严重，而基于社会出身的歧视则在住房市场中最为突出。针对发表偏倚的频率学稳健性检验也得出了类似的结果。

title: Three rules for airport problems: Characterizations via order preservation, dispersion minimization, and consistency
title_zh: 机场问题的三条规则：基于顺序保持、分散最小化与一致性的刻画
title_primary: 机场问题的三条规则：基于顺序保持、分散最小化与一致性的刻画
title_secondary: Three rules for airport problems: Characterizations via order preservation, dispersion minimization, and consistency
authors: Zeming Ma
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider a class of cost allocation problems where a public facility is shared by a group of agents with “needs” for it, and these needs possess a “nested” character. A facility accommodating an agent can also accommodate any other agent with a lower need at no extra cost. The facility has to be provided to accommodate all agents. The question is how to allocate its cost among them. An example is airlines sharing an airstrip. These problems are therefore known as “airport problems”. We identify desirable rules through the axiomatic approach. We propose three main axioms: (i) order preservation in contribution rates, which requires the order of agents’ contribution rates to match the order of their needs; (ii) minimizing the range of contribution rates, which requires that the difference between the highest and lowest contribution rates among agents be minimized; and (iii) single-constraint consistency, which is an expression of the well-known “consistency” principle. Drawing inspiration from the literature on economic design, we adapt the proportionality principle to guarantee that no group of agents subsidizes the complementary group. We call this resulting rule the “constrained proportional rule”. Our main result is that this rule is the only rule satisfying these three axioms. We also provide new characterizations of two other well-known rules. The “constrained equal contributions rule” is the only rule minimizing the variance of contributions. The “constrained equal benefits rule” is the only rule minimizing the range (or variance) of benefits.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一类成本分配问题，其中一项公共设施由一群对其有“需求”的代理人共享，且这些需求具有“嵌套”特征。容纳某一代理人的设施，也能以零额外成本容纳任何需求更低的代理人。该设施必须提供以容纳所有代理人。问题在于如何在代理人之间分配其成本。一个例子是航空公司共享一条跑道，因此这些问题被称为“机场问题”。我们通过公理化方法识别理想的规则。我们提出三个主要公理：（i）贡献率的顺序保持，要求代理人贡献率的顺序与其需求顺序一致；（ii）贡献率范围最小化，要求代理人中最高与最低贡献率之间的差异最小化；（iii）单约束一致性，这是著名的“一致性”原则的一种表达。借鉴经济设计文献中的思想，我们调整比例原则，以确保没有任何代理人群体补贴互补群体。我们将由此得到的规则称为“约束比例规则”。我们的主要结果是，该规则是唯一满足这三个公理的规则。我们还提供了另外两个著名规则的新特征化。“约束等贡献规则”是唯一使贡献方差最小化的规则。“约束等收益规则”是唯一使收益范围（或方差）最小化的规则。

title: Unity for longevity: Corporate collaboration culture and global innovation network integration
title_zh: 团结促长青：企业协作文化与全球创新网络整合
title_primary: 团结促长青：企业协作文化与全球创新网络整合
title_secondary: Unity for longevity: Corporate collaboration culture and global innovation network integration
authors: Yu He, Xiaomin Jiang, Tao Li, Ran Wei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the impact of corporate collaboration culture on firms' integration into global innovation networks. Using the number of firms' cross-border co-patents to measure global innovation integration, we find that the collaboration culture positively affects it. The positive effects are more pronounced for firms with lower risk-taking and higher information transparency. Moreover, the collaboration culture encourages firms to disclose more innovation-related information. These results reveal that the collaboration culture facilitates integration into global innovation networks by compensating for insufficient risk-taking and enhancing information transparency. Further analyses show that the collaboration culture improves the quality of cross-border co-patents. Strategically, firms prioritize co-patents related to the digital economy and green energy. The cooperation typically follows the pattern of Chinese applicants with foreign inventors. Taken together, these results underscore that corporate unity catalyzes longevity, enabling firms to achieve competitive endurance through integration into global innovation ecosystems.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了企业协作文化对企业融入全球创新网络的影响。以企业跨境合作专利数量衡量全球创新融入程度，我们发现协作文化对此产生积极影响。对于风险承担能力较低、信息透明度较高的企业，这种正面效应更为显著。此外，协作文化鼓励企业披露更多与创新相关的信息。这些结果表明，协作文化通过弥补风险承担不足和增强信息透明度，促进了企业融入全球创新网络。进一步分析显示，协作文化提升了跨境合作专利的质量。在战略层面，企业优先关注与数字经济及绿色能源相关的合作专利。合作模式通常表现为中国申请人与外国发明人相结合。综上所述，这些结果强调了企业内部的团结是持久发展的催化剂，使企业能够通过融入全球创新生态系统实现竞争耐力。

title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories‐Based Approach
title_zh: 基于轨迹方法的父母收入与家庭结构对代际流动的影响
title_primary: 基于轨迹方法的父母收入与家庭结构对代际流动的影响
title_secondary: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories‐Based Approach
authors: Yoosoon Chang, Steven N. Durlauf, Bo Hu, Joon Y. Park
official: 官方在线 2026-05-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high‐dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long‐term importance of early‐life familial conditions for adult economic success.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年及青少年时期的父母收入与家庭结构如何影响成年后的收入水平，并重点分析了这些影响的时间节点。通过采用含函数协变量的有序多项概率模型，本研究发现这些家庭因素在童年中期及青少年时期的影响最为显著。同时，研究揭示了关键发育阶段中收入与家庭结构轨迹的互补效应。借助非参数方法灵活控制个人及家庭特征，本模型有效处理了高维协变量问题。研究结果深化了对代际收入流动性的理解，并凸显了早期家庭环境对成年后经济成就的长期重要性。

title: A Tail of Labor Supply and a Tale of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 劳动供给的尾部与货币政策的故事
title_primary: 劳动供给的尾部与货币政策的故事
title_secondary: A Tail of Labor Supply and a Tale of Monetary Policy
authors: Cristiano Cantore, Filippo Ferroni, Haroon Mumtaz, Angeliki Theophilopoulou
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the interaction between monetary policy and labor supply decisions at the household level. We uncover evidence of heterogeneous responses and a strong countercyclicality of hours worked in the left tail of the income distribution following a monetary policy shock in the US. Specifically, while aggregate hours and labor earnings decline after a monetary tightening, individuals at the bottom of the income distribution increase their hours worked. Moreover, this positive labor supply response is quantitatively significant, substantially dampening the decline in aggregate hours worked. We show that the empirical patterns are consistent with a standard one-asset HANK model featuring endogenous labor supply. The model reveals that strong income effects at the bottom of the distribution can account for the observed countercyclical labor responses, highlighting how labor supply adjustments act as an additional margin through which households smooth consumption. Comparing this specification to a model with a homogeneous labor supply, we find that labor supply heterogeneity reduces the aggregate MPC and attenuates the transmission of monetary policy through aggregate demand. As a result, the output cost of disinflation is lower in economies where poorer households can flexibly adjust their labor effort, easing the trade-off faced by the central bank.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了货币政策与家庭层面劳动供给决策之间的相互作用。我们发现了美国货币政策冲击后劳动供给的异质性反应证据，以及收入分布左尾工作时长的强逆周期性特征。具体而言，当货币紧缩导致总工时和劳动收入下降时，收入分布底层的个体反而增加了工作时长。此外，这种正向劳动供给反应在数量上具有显著性，显著缓解了总工时的下降幅度。我们证明，这些实证特征与包含内生劳动供给的标准单资产HANK模型一致。模型揭示，收入分布底层的强收入效应可以解释所观察到的逆周期劳动反应，凸显了劳动供给调整作为家庭平滑消费的额外渠道。将该设定与同质劳动供给模型对比发现，劳动供给异质性降低了总边际消费倾向，并削弱了货币政策通过总需求的传导效应。因此，在贫困家庭能灵活调整劳动投入的经济体中，通胀抑制的产出成本更低，从而缓解了央行面临的权衡取舍。

title: Timing, uncertainty, and opportunity cost: Lessons for ecosystem modification on the Colorado River
title_zh: 时机、不确定性与机会成本：科罗拉多河生态系统改造的启示
title_primary: 时机、不确定性与机会成本：科罗拉多河生态系统改造的启示
title_secondary: Timing, uncertainty, and opportunity cost: Lessons for ecosystem modification on the Colorado River
authors: Pierce Donovan, Lucas S. Bair, Matthew N. Reimer, Michael R. Springborn, Charles B. Yackulic
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While conservation goals have long been pursued through traditional species-augmenting actions, a broader set of episodic ecosystem modification (EEM) actions, such as hydropower dam releases, prescribed fire, and beach nourishment, is garnering attention. EEM actions face several implementation challenges stemming from high opportunity costs, delayed effect mechanisms, reliance on monitoring for deployment timing, and outcome uncertainty due to infrequent use. In this paper, we study the use of EEM actions in the form of designer flows—ecologically-motivated releases of water into regulated river segments—to maintain a viable population of a threatened native fish species in the Colorado River. We demonstrate how the cost-effectiveness of EEM actions can be hampered by the complex and delayed effects on species viability, but enhanced through targeted monitoring for timing deployment and experimentation for reducing uncertainty about effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，保护目标一直通过传统的物种增殖行动来实现，然而，一系列更广泛的间歇性生态系统改造（EEM）行动，如水力发电大坝泄流、计划烧除和海滩养护，正日益受到关注。EEM行动面临若干实施挑战，这些挑战源于高昂的机会成本、延迟的效应机制、依赖监测来确定部署时机，以及因使用频率低而导致的结果不确定性。本文研究了以设计流量形式——即出于生态动机向受管制河段放水——实施的EEM行动，用以维持科罗拉多河中一种受威胁本土鱼类种群的生存能力。我们展示了EEM行动的成本效益如何因对物种生存能力的复杂且延迟的影响而受到制约，但通过有针对性的监测以确定部署时机和通过实验减少效果不确定性，其成本效益可以得到提升。

title: Bayesian estimation of a large-scale macroeconomic policy agent-based model
title_zh: 大规模宏观经济政策基于主体模型的贝叶斯估计
title_primary: 大规模宏观经济政策基于主体模型的贝叶斯估计
title_secondary: Bayesian estimation of a large-scale macroeconomic policy agent-based model
authors: Sylvain Barde
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Empirical parameter estimation of large scale agent-based models has long been recognised as computationally challenging. Their bottom-up nature imposes the use of non-parametric or indirect inference methods, which in turn typically requires a significant amount simulated data. However, their high computational requirements makes the application of these estimation methodologies unfeasible in practice. This hurdle can limit the applicability of agent based models for quantitative policy advice, for example in scenario analysis, in cases where the parameter calibration cannot be checked against empirical data. We show how this problem can be overcome by estimating the Dosi et al. (2015) agent-based model. This extends the original ‘Keynes meets Schumpeter’ model of Dosi et al. (2010) allowing for the interaction of fiscal and monetary policy. 18 free parameters of the model are estimated on 10 standard macroeconomic US variables, using annual and quarterly data, and the estimates obtained are shown to improve the fit of the baseline model on the data. A model-selection exercise is carried out, investigating impact of changing the expectation-formation mechanism. Finally, the original policy experiments are replicated using the new empirical estimates, showing that pushing the model into a low-growth regime leads to several key differences relative to the original conclusions. Overall, the exercise establishes the feasibility and relevance of macro-economic empirical parameter estimation and mechanism selection to ABM designers for improving the fit of scenario analyses.
abstract_zh: 大规模基于主体的模型的经验参数估计长期以来被认为是计算上的挑战。其自下而上的特性要求使用非参数或间接推断方法，这通常需要大量的模拟数据。然而，这些方法的高计算需求使得在实际中应用这些估计方法变得不可行。这一障碍可能限制基于主体的模型在定量政策建议中的应用，例如在情景分析中，当参数校准无法与经验数据对照时。我们展示了如何通过估计Dosi等人（2015）的基于主体模型来克服这一问题。该模型扩展了Dosi等人（2010）原始的“凯恩斯遇见熊彼特”模型，允许财政与货币政策之间的相互作用。模型的18个自由参数基于10个标准美国宏观经济变量，使用年度和季度数据进行估计，所得估计结果被证明能改善基线模型对数据的拟合度。我们进行了模型选择练习，考察了改变预期形成机制的影响。最后，使用新的经验估计重复了原始政策实验，结果显示将模型推入低增长状态会导致与原始结论相比的几个关键差异。总体而言，这项工作确立了宏观经济经验参数估计和机制选择对ABM设计者而言的可行性和相关性，以改善情景分析的拟合度。

title: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market
title_zh: 长短之辨：美国住房市场中的存量-流量匹配
title_primary: 长短之辨：美国住房市场中的存量-流量匹配
title_secondary: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market
authors: Eric Smith, Zoe Xie, Lei Fang
official: 官方在线 2026-04-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: From 2006 until 2020, the probability of selling a house in the U.S. declined sharply after listing for 2 weeks. Moreover, sales within the first 2 weeks of listing (“quick sales”) and sales happening afterward (“slow sales”) behaved differently over the housing cycle. The probability and associated price of a quick sale recovered from the slump sooner, faster, and more prominently than a slow sale. This paper demonstrates that a calibrated stock-flow matching model not only generates quantitatively consistent sales, prices, listings, and time on the market but also captures distinctions between fast and slow sales over the housing cycle.
abstract_zh: 从2006年至2020年，美国房屋挂牌两周后售出的概率急剧下降。此外，挂牌后两周内售出（“快速销售”）与之后售出（“慢速销售”）在房地产周期中的表现存在差异。快速销售的概率及其相关价格从低谷中恢复得更早、更快且更为显著，相比之下慢速销售则不然。本文证明，一个校准的存量-流量匹配模型不仅能在数量上生成一致的销售量、价格、挂牌量及市场停留时间，还能捕捉住房周期中快速与慢速销售之间的差异。

title: Welfare properties of the Taiwan mechanism
title_zh: 台湾机制的福利性质
title_primary: 台湾机制的福利性质
title_secondary: Welfare properties of the Taiwan mechanism
authors: Ilan Wolff
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-11-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper analyzes the welfare properties of the mechanism Taiwan uses to match students to high schools. I study the Taiwan mechanism under a theoretical model where students share the same ordinal rankings, and a single lottery determines schools’ preferences. In this setting, all Taiwan mechanisms ex ante weakly Pareto dominate deferred acceptance for strategizing students. Additionally, in my model, there always exists a Taiwan mechanism that provides greater welfare than deferred acceptance to students who do not strategize. Using Cambridge Public School data, I demonstrate that the Taiwan mechanism outperforms deferred acceptance for a range of deduction rules.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了台湾地区用于将学生匹配至高中的机制的福利性质。我在一个理论模型下研究台湾机制，该模型假设学生具有相同的序数排名，且单一抽签决定学校的偏好。在此设定下，所有台湾机制在事前弱帕累托优于延迟接受机制，对策略性学生而言。此外，在我的模型中，总存在一种台湾机制，能为不采取策略的学生提供比延迟接受机制更高的福利。利用剑桥公立学校数据，我证明台湾机制在一系列扣分规则下均优于延迟接受机制。

title: Extending policies to control groups or past periods in nonlinear difference in differences
title_zh: 非线性双重差分中政策向控制组或过去时期的扩展
title_primary: 非线性双重差分中政策向控制组或过去时期的扩展
title_secondary: Extending policies to control groups or past periods in nonlinear difference in differences
authors: Eugene Lee, Myoung‐jae Lee, Goeun Lee
official: 官方在线 2025-09-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In difference in differences (DD), a policy D is applied to a qualified group (Q=1) at a period. Going beyond simply finding the policy effect, however, the policy maker may desire to find the effect of extending the policy to the Q=0 group or to a pre-policy period. For a continuous outcome Y, typically a linear model is adopted where the policy effect is the constant slope of D, in which case the constant effect applies to untreated units or past periods. However, if Y is binary (or noncontinuous, more generally) so that a nonlinear DD occurs and the policy effect is inherently heterogeneous, then extending the policy becomes involved, as the effect depends nonlinearly on covariates. We show how to do policy extensions and inference in nonlinear DD to aid the policy maker in deciding whether to expand the policy or not, and we provide two empirical illustrations.
abstract_zh: 在双重差分（DD）方法中，政策D在某一时期适用于合格群体（Q=1）。然而，政策制定者可能不仅希望找到政策效应，还希望了解将政策扩展至Q=0群体或政策前时期的效果。对于连续结果变量Y，通常采用线性模型，其中政策效应是D的恒定斜率，此时恒定效应适用于未受处理的单位或过去时期。但如果Y是二值变量（或更一般地，非连续变量），则会出现非线性DD，且政策效应本质上具有异质性，此时政策扩展变得复杂，因为效应依赖于协变量的非线性关系。我们展示了如何在非线性DD中进行政策扩展与推断，以帮助政策制定者决定是否扩大政策范围，并提供了两个实证案例说明。
